Through the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation lens, the operating reality: Renewable operators industrialize asset performance: turbine and inverter health, generation forecasting, PPA settlement and hybrid-plant optimization. Margins live in availability percentage points and forecast accuracy — both telemetry problems.

The fix for GO/REC integrity is rarely another screen. It is a governed path between the systems that already exist — instrumented, bounded, and owned by someone with the authority to change the process.

items: Technician routing and parts by spreadsheet; weather windows missed.
Turbines/inverters fail unscheduled; availability points lost.
Generation forecasts feed trading poorly; imbalance costs.
